purpose: Check whether newly published perpetual-futures research warrants a distinct Experiment 0016 without inspecting project return data.

sources_reviewed.title: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
sources_reviewed.authors: Chan Kim and Peter Reinhard Hansen
sources_reviewed.finding_used: The paper reports that quarter-hour opening order imbalance forecasts four-to-twelve-hour futures returns across six Binance perpetual contracts.

sources_reviewed.title: How Much Sharpe is Illusory? Quantifying Backtest Overfitting in Crypto Factor Strategies
sources_reviewed.author: Sergey Nefedov
sources_reviewed.finding_used: The paper motivates pre-committed configurations, explicit costs, and selection-bias corrections; it is not used as return evidence.

candidates.name: QUARTER_HOUR_OPENING_ORDER_IMBALANCE
candidates.reason: Alpha 011 already fixed the same core information set before its first forward observation: ten-second order imbalance after 00:15 and 12:15 UTC boundaries, a one-second availability buffer, 12-hour non-overlapping holding, actual funding, and taker fee/slippage stress. A second trial would duplicate the family and create avoidable multiple-testing risk.
candidates.required_next_evidence: Continue Alpha 011's preregistered forward collection; do not open a duplicate experiment or alter its boundaries, window, horizon, costs, or gates.

candidates.name: DAILY_PRICE_VOLUME_FACTOR_SORTS
candidates.reason: The available daily archive reconstruction can support a future point-in-time diagnostic, but no independently reproducible signal rule, turnover specification, and funding-aware execution protocol was identified in this screen. Opening a factor search now would violate the pre-commitment objective.
candidates.required_next_evidence: A complete method source and a separate preregistration after the historical universe audit passes.

selected_next_step: NO_NEW_EXPERIMENT; keep Alpha 011 and the historical-universe reconstruction protocols unchanged.
